patch.description: Patch body in apply_patch format; paths workspace-relative by default.

target_id.description: Exact target_id returned by list_execution_locations. Do not pass a location name, type, or runtime ID. Omit to use the default location for the current turn.

background_mode.description: task (default) uses the execution budget; service runs until stopped or the workspace closes (requires run_in_background=true, no max_duration_seconds).

command.description: Command to run (e.g. ls -la, npm install, python script.py)

description.description: Short active-voice description of the command, e.g. ls -la → "List files with details".

max_duration_seconds.description: Total budget including foreground time (min 30, default 7200, max 86400); backgrounding does not restart it.

run_in_background.description: Run in background; returns a task ID immediately (no trailing '&'). For long commands (installs, builds, tests) and non-exiting processes (servers, watch mode). Inspect with wait_until(task_id), then get_background_status(task_id).

target_id.description: Exact target_id returned by list_execution_locations. Do not pass a location name, type, or runtime ID. Omit to use the default location for the current turn.

timeout.description: Foreground wait in seconds (default 30, max 600); a still-running command then moves to the background, possibly earlier to preserve max_duration_seconds.

limit.description: Entries per call; default and max 200.
